why: The cheapest gap the inventory audit found, and it did not come from any video: it is the most deterministic pattern there is in a repository built with AI. Each literal is a human decision recorded on one line -- somebody switched the protection off so the demo would stop erroring and never switched it back on. The pass side carries the false positive that takes down a naive detector: the SAME literal written inside a comment, documenting why it must NOT be used. Without `semComentarioNemImport` the pass side goes red, and this module's own rules file would accuse itself.
